（自由記述欄）
This course is for the beginner students who have no or little previous knowledge of Japanese.
履修条件
Stundents who want to take this course must be zero-/almost zero-beginner students. If not, they cannot get a credit.
授業概要
This course aims at
a. acquiring basic Japanese communication skills that are needed for daily life and studying in Japan.
b. understanding Japanese cultural and social traits,
c. mastering how to study Japanese language.
授業形態
（項目）
□ Lecture・Seminar
□ Group Work・Pair Work
授業形態
（内容）
Flipped class
使用する教材等
handouts
全体の教育目標
Students will be able to live in Japan without much anxiety.
個別の教育目標
By the end of this semester, students will
1. be able to interact in a simple way if the other person talks slowly and clearly,
2. become more interested in Japanese culture and society,
3. acquire the language learning strategies to keep studying without teacher's help.
